items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: It was me and Howard and Dave, John Guerin, and Chuck Domanico. ... I want to do a jazz album with my quartet which at the time was Mike Lang on piano, Chuck Domanico on bass and John Guerin on drums.

ctx.x: From your quote resume, it looks like you weren’t just happy with being a saxophone player. I mean by that that you have film credits and conducting and arranging. Did that all develop about in the same time?

Well roughly. I mean here’s what happened. The first, if I remember this correctly, the first job that I was offered to write an episode of a television show was Universal. The music supervisor at Universal was a guy named Stanley Wilson, a friend of my father’s, they had worked together, there are probably pictures, years ago. But I was sort of, you know, getting a reputation as this guy, this musical guy, and I had written a couple of tunes for Emil Richards, kind of odd time tunes and other things. I don’t…
